skills.name: Telephone Punch
skills.description: Takes a big swing and punches with full force. Bad effects on enemies  *ATK x 2800% Area Damage  *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -40% (10 sec) *Enemy Skill Resistance -40% (10 sec)

skills.name: War Cry
skills.description: Howls at the sky. Good effects on allies  *Move Speed +170% (7 sec) *ATK Speed +300% (7 sec) *Critical Rate +50% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Baki Hanma
abilities.description: Baki Hanma Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Enemy Cost Increase
abilities.description: Gives a high chance of increasing the Mineral Cost for one of the opposing team's Rangers when Rangers with this Ability are deployed. This Ability can activate from 10 seconds after the battle starts.
